concerns.text: Task T012 (Synthetic Genomics) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The plan explicitly requires synthetic genomic features and labels as the primary data source for the 'Validation Mode' pipeline. Without this task being implemented, the entire downstream pipeline (T013, T020, T021) has no input data, rendering the project non-functional.

Task T016a (Synthetic Phylogenetic Matrix) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The plan and FR-009 require a phylogenetic distance matrix for the KNN baseline. The plan states no verified tree exists, making this synthetic generation mandatory. Its absence blocks T021 (Baseline Training).

Task T016c (Fetch Real Phylogenetic Tree) is marked as unchecked [ ]. While the plan notes a verified tree may not exist, the spec (FR-002) and plan logic (T014a) require an attempt to fetch a real tree to enable Phylogenetic MICE. The task must exist to implement the 'try real, fallback to synthetic' logic described in the plan.

Task T013 (Merge Data) is marked as unchecked [ ]. This is the core of User Story 1 (FR-002). Without this task, the physiological and genomic data (real or synthetic) cannot be combined, blocking all modeling tasks.

Task T014a (Imputation Logic) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The spec (FR-002) and plan require handling missing continuous traits via Phylogenetic MICE or Median Substitution. This task is critical for data integrity and is currently unimplemented.

Task T023 (DeLong's Test) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The spec (FR-010, SC-001) mandates comparing the best model against the baseline using DeLong's test. This is a core success criterion and is currently missing implementation.

Task T025 (Unit test for paired t-test) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The spec (FR-005) requires a paired t-test. While T027 implements the logic, T025 is the required unit test for this logic. The plan requires tests for each story.

Task T026 (Integration test for feature importance) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The spec (FR-006) requires feature importance output. T028 implements the logic, but T026 is the required integration test to verify the output format and content.
Task T027 (Paired t-test implementation) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The spec (FR-005) explicitly requires a paired t-test on CV AUC scores. This task is currently unimplemented.
Task T028 (Permutation Feature Importance) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The spec (FR-006) requires generating feature importance rankings. This task is currently unimplemented.

Task T029 (Final Report Generation) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The spec (US-3) and plan require a final report including statistical comparisons and feature importance. This task is currently unimplemented.
Task T034 (Quickstart Validation) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The plan requires verifying the pipeline runs within 30 minutes. This task is currently unimplemented.

Task T041 (Pipeline Entry Point) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The quickstart.md and plan reference `code/run_pipeline.py` as the single entry point. This script does not exist yet, blocking the execution of the full pipeline.
Task T043 (Data Source Verification) is marked as unchecked [ ]. This task addresses a specific review concern regarding data integrity and URL verification. It is currently unimplemented.
Task T044 (Phylogenetic Tree Availability Check) is marked as unchecked [ ]. This task addresses a specific review concern regarding tree availability and logging. It is currently unimplemented.

Task T045 (Synthetic Data Validation) is marked as unchecked [ ]. This task addresses a specific review concern regarding the validation of synthetic data distributions. It is currently unimplemented.
Task T047 (Feature Importance Validation) is marked as unchecked [ ]. This task addresses a specific review concern regarding the distribution of feature importance. It is currently unimplemented.
